set.body:
Scope: mvpa-spatial surface adapters; optional ../mvpa4s surface integration.

Deliverable: Finish generic surface measurement/searchlight/scatter adapters over the extracted neuro-surface provider. Keep atlas and functional-analysis policy in ScalaFIM.

Acceptance:
- Generic surface adapter builds outside ScalaFIM and preserves domain/vertex order, masking and scatter semantics on JVM/JS.
- Volume and surface measurement scenarios consume the same MVPA evidence contracts.
- No back-edge from neurosurf4s to mvpa4s or ScalaFIM is introduced; old adapter implementations are deleted.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U6: Compose MVPA surface measurements over neurosurf4s
